metadata.question: Was the nighttime brightness around the Blue Lagoon in Iceland on November 24, 2024, greater than the brightness over Reykjavík at 4 am local time?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need VIIRS nighttime lights data (DNB - Day/Night Band) - Date: November 24, 2024 - Locations: Blue Lagoon (approximately 63.88°N, 22.45°W) and Reykjavík (approximately 64.15°N, 21.95°W) - VIIRS DNB collection: "NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG" or daily data if available 2. Masking strategy: - For nighttime lights, we want actual brightness values, no cloud masking needed - The question asks about brightness comparison, so we need the radiance values 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid Zero: Blue Lagoon or Reykjavík could legitimately have 0 or low brightness - C1: No images available for the date/location - C2: After processing, no valid pixels (unlikely for nighttime lights) - C3: Result is None/NaN or calculation fails - A: Blue Lagoon brightness > Reykjavík brightness - B: Blue Lagoon brightness <= Reykjavík brightness ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const blueLagoon = ee.Geometry.Point([-22.45, 63.88]); const reykjavik = ee.Geometry.Point([-21.95, 64.15]); const startDate = '2024-11-01'; const endDate = '2024-11-30'; // 2. Data Acquisition & Check // VIIRS DNB monthly composite (most reliable for nighttime lights) let collection = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG') .filterDate(startDate, endDate); const collectionSize = await collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Collection size: ${collectionSize}`); if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log("No VIIRS data available for November 2024."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Get the image for November 2024 const image = collection.first(); const band = 'avg_rad'; // Average radiance band // Buffer points slightly to get representative area const blueLagoonArea = blueLagoon.buffer(500); const reykjavikArea = reykjavik.buffer(500); // 4. Calculation - Get brightness for both locations const blueLagoonStats = await image.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: blueLagoonArea, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const reykjavikStats = await image.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: reykjavikArea, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); // Get pixel counts to check for C2 const blueLagoonCount = await image.select(band).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: blueLagoonArea, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const reykjavikCount = await image.select(band).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: reykjavikArea, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const blPixels = blueLagoonCount[band]; const rvkPixels = reykjavikCount[band]; console.log(`Blue Lagoon pixels: ${blPixels}, Reykjavik pixels: ${rvkPixels}`); if (blPixels === 0 || rvkPixels === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels after processing."); console.log("C2"); return; } const blueLagoonBrightness = blueLagoonStats[band]; const reykjavikBrightness = reykjavikStats[band]; // 5. Validation & Final Answer console.log(`Blue Lagoon brightness: ${blueLagoonBrightness}`); console.log(`Reykjavik brightness: ${reykjavikBrightness}`); if (blueLagoonBrightness === null || blueLagoonBrightness === undefined || reykjavikBrightness === null || reykjavikBrightness === undefined || isNaN(blueLagoonBrightness) || isNaN(reykjavikBrightness)) { console.log("Calculation failed - invalid results."); console.log("C3"); return; } if (blueLagoonBrightness > reykjavikBrightness) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
